construction.n_updates_semantics: PPO.train increments _n_updates once per epoch; exact train, epoch and optimizer counts are derived from the attached BudgetSpec
construction.seed_side_effect: PPO(seed=the explicit run seed) calls set_random_seed and env.seed; that only reseeds the env measurement stream, not root's physical command seeds

note: counts and hashes only; reward level, 1.5 m/s capability and any RL contribution must come from root's heldout pairs
